messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@brightlane.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightlane.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term headroom for Brightlane launch

Hi Rafael,

We're ramping to production for our new campaign on June 30 and expect a sharp but short lived spike in inference volume during the first 10 days. The product team estimates ~18M extra tokens/day at peak for ~72 hours across the initial rollout region.

Can Redwood provide a short-term headroom/top-up and what would the pricing look like? We need to understand:
- a) an upfront 48–72 hour burst window (best-effort) and the rate you would charge per-token for that window;
- b) how overrun true-ups would be reconciled (monthly? pro-rata?) and whether any credits apply if we convert to a committed tier after launch;
- c) whether we can split the charge across two internal cost centers (Product / Ads) and have line-item allocation for accounting.

Attached is a simple forecast (launch_traffic_forecast.csv). Procurement copied for PO logistics.

Thanks — can we get a written proposal today or tomorrow?

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Product, Brightlane

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term headroom for Brightlane launch

Elena — thanks for the forecast and heads-up. Copying Jordan (AE) and Monica (Customer Ops) to align on ops and invoicing. Below is a concise proposal with three options — pick the one closest to your procurement/finance preference and we'll finalize a PO/DocuSign.

Proposal (options):

Option A — 72-hour burst window (fastest):
- Provisioned headroom: up to 60M tokens total over 72 hours (can be increased by request)
- Rate: $0.015 per 1k tokens (burst premium)
- Overrun reconciliation: monthly true-up; any usage beyond headroom billed at normal hosted rates unless you convert to a committed commit within 30 days of launch;
- Split billing: we can apply allocation tags so charges are split 60/40 between Product/Ads and delivered as separate line items on the invoice.

Option B — 72-hour burst + conditional credit:
- Same headroom as A, billed at $0.012 per 1k tokens upfront;
- If you convert >= $60k/mo committed capacity within 30 days, Redwood will credit 25% of burst fees against the first committed month invoice (one-time credit);
- Split billing supported via allocation tags.

Option C — Conservative buffer + monthly cap:
- 48-hour headroom, lower premium $0.009 per 1k tokens;
- Built-in monthly overrun cap: we cap total overrun charges at 150% of forecasted monthly run-rate for the first 2 invoices;
- Good if finance wants predictable upper-bound.

Operational notes:
- We will not change your existing rate limits automatically; this is a temporary headroom allocation scoped to the burst window. If you need a permanent rate-limit bump, that's a separate procurement step.
- To enable split-charge accounting we need BU codes for invoice line-items; Monica will follow up with a short form to capture ledger tags.

Attachments: burst_pricing_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal summary)

Next steps: Reply with preferred option + cost center codes and procurement contact for the PO. If you prefer, Jordan can schedule a 30-minute call today to run the numbers.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

- Provisioned headroom: 60M tokens (with an option to request +20M before the window starts).
- Billing: Option B elected — upfront headroom billed at $0.012 per 1k tokens.

- PO and legal: procurement@brightlane.com to share purchase order (AOA_PO_4567.pdf) and we'll route the DocuSign with the short-headroom addendum.

Elena — if the summary looks good, procurement can: 1) send PO to billing@redwood.ai; 2) complete and return the cost center form Monica will send; 3) accept the DocuSign when it arrives. We'll enable the headroom once the DocuSign is executed and the PO reference number is in our system.
